about: The one park-list job (kpc_pota_parklists.py, KPC owner 2026-11-16, handoff item 7, v4): POTA's all-parks export (all_parks_ext.csv, checked Nov 16, 2026: 106,058 parks, fields reference, name, active, entityId, locationDesc, latitude, longitude, grid) is read once a day and compared with yesterday's copy; only changed locations are rewritten. /location/parks/<loc> only for a changed location whose jobs need a field the export lacks (extra_fields_locations any day; world_extra_locations on the world day), at most max_lists_per_run. If the export is gone, US / CA lists are re-pulled after home_list_max_days (fallback).
